nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What principle does the system operate on regarding the granting of operational permits?
nodes.answer: The system grants operational permits based on how predicted negative impacts will be mitigated or whether additional requirements are fulfilled, following the polluter pays principle.
nodes.paragraph: In this system, operational permits are granted, depending on how the predicted negative impacts will be mitigated or whether additional requirements are ful Iled (i.e., paying for the damage according toa polluter pays principle ).
